# Drop The Strap Marketing

> We no longer ask for a URL and a keyword. A URL is a location. A keyword is a guess. Neither one is the business.

Drop The Strap Marketing is a Memphis-based company. Your website is a sales asset. Humans and AI both have to understand who you serve and how they get started. We review. We don’t take the keys.

## About

Named after Jerry "The King" Lawler's signature move — pulling down one strap of his singlet to signal the finisher was coming.

Memphis-based. Two locations — Memphis and Collierville, Tennessee. Serving clients nationally.

## How to start

Tell us who you serve. We need three things, in your words:

1. What the business does
2. Who the ideal customer is
3. What a future customer must do to become a paying customer

Not a target keyword. Not a six-month essay. If you want someone to take a URL and “do the SEO,” this isn’t that.

Required: name, email, and those three answers.
Optional: phone, website URL.
